purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Iringa

queries.query: Iringa Tanzania official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party results identified the Iringa Municipal Council master plan, the Iringa regional government site, and the Ministry of Lands e-Ardhi portal. Official material evidences land surveying, mapped plots and land offices, but no anonymous public parcel viewer or feature API was exposed.

queries.query: Iringa Tanzania ramani viwanja kadastri ardhi rasmi
queries.result: First-party Swahili results identified the Iringa municipal and regional government sites and Ministry of Lands services. The official evidence describes viwanja, upimaji, ramani and e-Ardhi, but did not expose an anonymous parcel ID+geometry endpoint.

registryEvidence.custodian: Iringa Municipal Council land/planning administration, with the Ministry of Lands, Housing and Human Settlements Development as the national land-registration and e-Ardhi custodian.
registryEvidence.locality: Iringa city is within Iringa Municipal Council; the municipal master plan and municipal government pages are first-party local evidence.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This establishes a local government land/planning custodian and national land-service custodian, not public parcel-data availability, citywide coverage, or legal title coverage.

parcelDiscovery.note: The public e-Ardhi portal and official municipal/regional pages were inspected for the current viewer, JavaScript/configuration, map/API links, schema and CRS. e-Ardhi presents services and account registration/login; the public route requires identity/phone or account authentication. No anonymous parcel ID+geometry response was available, so no GeoJSON was retained.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official Iringa Municipal Council master-plan document found; it contains land/planning material and references land notices, but no public parcel API or downloadable parcel layer was exposed.
Official Iringa Municipal Council page found; map/site links were visible in indexed material, but no anonymous cadastral feature service or parcel schema was exposed.
Official Iringa regional government site retrieved in indexed search; it provides government information and map/navigation links, but no public parcel feature service was exposed.
Official Ministry e-Ardhi public portal identified; it describes land planning, surveying/mapping, ownership, registration and valuation services, with account-based access.

Official registration route exposes NIN, phone and OTP/security-question fields; this is an authentication/identity wall. No credentials, OTP, private token or unsafe owner/title fields were requested.
Official login route lists phone, NIN and email login; no anonymous map/API or parcel geometry response was exposed.

Official Ministry notice confirms e-Ardhi supports planning, surveying, land allocation, registration and valuation, and lists initial rollout areas; it does not publish a public anonymous parcel layer for Iringa.
Official Iringa regional report records surveyed plots, farms and issued land documents and the establishment of the Iringa regional land office; it contains no public parcel geometry endpoint.

uncertainty: The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted; no anonymous exact-point parcel query was available to execute.
The e-Ardhi portal may contain additional land records behind authentication, but this research did not log in or test private/authenticated routes.
Registry presence is based on first-party local and national land-administration evidence; it does not establish public parcel-data access or complete citywide coverage.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
